escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Europe this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, World's Biggest Human Catapult 🤯, by Red Bull, with over 9 thousand comments.
In second place, ПЕТЯ ИНГЛИШ: НАЧАЛО, by Petya English, with over 11 thousand comments.
And number one: KARM6 - İki Yüzlü (Official Music Video), by KARM6, with over 19 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
